features.description: Wire BehaviorScheduler to runtime — morning greeting, break reminders, idle comments fire on schedule
steps: Verify BehaviorScheduler triggers morning_greeting between 8-9am
Verify break_reminder fires after 60min continuous activity
Verify idle_comment fires after 10min idle
Verify trigger cooldowns prevent duplicate firings
Verify scheduler records activity timestamps correctly

features.description: Wire CareSystem decay to runtime — needs decay on demand in get_care_state
steps: Verify get_care_state applies elapsed-time decay before returning
Verify hunger decays at -1.0/hr, happiness at -0.5/hr, energy at -0.3/hr, social at -0.2/hr
Verify needs clamp to 0 after decay
Verify mood recalculated after decay

features.description: LLM error recovery — graceful fallback when API fails
steps: Simulate network error on primary LLM provider
Verify fallback to secondary provider activates
Simulate all providers failing
Verify rule-based fallback generates response
Verify no panic or crash on any error path
Verify error is logged appropriately

features.description: System tray icon and menu — tray icon appears, menu with show/hide, settings, quit
steps: Launch app and verify tray icon appears in system tray
Right-click tray icon and verify menu appears with: Show/Hide, Settings, Quit
Click Show/Hide to toggle pet window visibility
Click Settings to open settings panel
Click Quit to close the application
Verify tray icon tooltip shows app name

features.description: Settings UI panel — full settings panel with LLM config, appearance, behavior preferences
steps: Open settings panel from tray menu or keyboard shortcut
Verify LLM provider configuration section (provider type, API key, model, base URL)
Verify appearance section (pet name, theme selection)
Verify behavior section (auto-launch toggle, break reminder interval)
Verify Save and Cancel buttons work
Verify settings panel can be closed without losing unsaved changes (confirmation)

features.description: Settings persistence — settings saved to SQLite and survive app restarts
steps: Save settings via settings panel
Close and restart the application
Verify all settings are preserved (LLM config, pet name, behavior prefs)
Verify settings loaded match what was saved

features.description: Auto-launch registration — app starts with OS after enabling in settings
steps: Enable auto-launch in settings panel
Verify registry entry (Windows) or login item (macOS) is created
Restart OS or log out/in
Verify Ditto starts automatically
Disable auto-launch in settings
Verify registry entry/login item is removed

features.description: Custom pet theme loading — load external spritesheet + animation JSON
steps: Place custom spritesheet.png and animations.json in a theme directory
Select custom theme in settings
Verify app loads the custom spritesheet and animation definitions
Verify pet renders with new sprites
Verify animation states (idle, walk, sleep) use custom frame sequences
Verify reverting to default theme works

features.description: First-run onboarding wizard — guides user through setup
steps: Delete app data / fresh install
Launch app for first time
Verify onboarding wizard appears with steps: name pet, choose appearance, configure LLM
Complete each step and verify values are saved
Verify wizard does not appear on subsequent launches

features.description: Auto-update detection — detects new version and offers to install
steps: Configure update endpoint in tauri.conf.json
Verify app checks for updates on startup
When new version available, verify update notification appears
Verify user can accept or dismiss update
Verify update downloads and installs correctly

features.description: Windows installer — .msi installs, runs, uninstalls cleanly
steps: Build Windows installer: cargo tauri build
Run .msi installer and verify installation completes
Verify app appears in Start Menu
Verify app launches from Start Menu shortcut
Uninstall via Add/Remove Programs
Verify all files are cleaned up

features.description: macOS installer — .dmg installs, runs, uninstalls cleanly
steps: Build macOS installer on macOS hardware
Open .dmg and drag to Applications
Verify app launches from Applications
Move to Trash and verify cleanup
Launch app and let it idle for 60 seconds
Measure RAM usage via Task Manager / Activity Monitor
Verify RAM < 50MB
Measure CPU usage over 30 second window
Verify average CPU < 5%

features.description: Performance with active LLM call — <200MB RAM, <15% CPU
steps: Launch app with LLM provider configured
Send a chat message to trigger LLM call
During active streaming response, measure RAM
Verify RAM < 200MB during LLM call
Measure CPU during response streaming
Verify average CPU < 15%

features.description: Offline operation — app works without internet using rule-based behavior only
steps: Disconnect from internet
Launch app (or restart if already running)
Verify pet appears and animates normally
Verify pet walks, falls, reacts to cursor
Open chat and send a message
Verify rule-based fallback generates a response (no error/crash)
Verify care system works offline
Verify settings are accessible offline

features.description: Graceful data corruption recovery — app recovers from corrupted database or config
steps: Corrupt the SQLite database file (write garbage bytes)
Launch app and verify it detects corruption
Verify app recreates database with fresh schema
Verify app continues running without crash
Verify default settings are loaded after recovery

features.description: Accessibility — keyboard navigation and screen reader support for settings
steps: Open settings panel
Navigate all controls using Tab/Shift+Tab
Verify focus indicators are visible
Verify Enter/Space activates buttons and toggles
Verify screen reader announces control labels
